_comment: Lookup table (SCOPE FR4 / G3). SCAFFOLD generated 2026-07-29 from the four demo queries. Every `where` value below is EMPTY on purpose — a human fills it. `_hint` is quoted from the requirement's own wording where the source names its own issuer; `_evidence` is why the row exists. Delete `_hint`/`_evidence` when signing a row, set `source_url` to the page you checked, and set `verified_on` to the date. A row with an empty source_url still resolves but is flagged needs_human_review, so an unsigned row is visible in the answer as unverified rather than silently trusted.
_how_to_fill: For each row: open the official page, confirm where a citizen actually obtains that document, write it in `where` (the citizen-facing phrase, Arabic) and `issuing_authority` (the formal body). Put the URL you checked in `source_url` and today's date in `verified_on`. If you cannot confirm it, LEAVE IT EMPTY — an unresolved document is honest, a wrong office costs a citizen a day.
_not_included: 21 documents came back unresolved across the four demo queries; only the 9 below are documents. The other 12 are procedural RULES the extractor could not separate from requirements (e.g. «لا يُمنح القاصر دون الثامنة عشرة… إلا بعد موافقة الوالدين»). Do not add rows for those — they are not documents and a lookup row would put an office next to a sentence that is not a thing you can collect. See report §6.3 failure mode 3.

rows.notes: Not issued by anyone on application: it is the applicant's own existing passport. Both /ar/posts/11 («جواز السفر السابق في حال وجوده») and /ar/posts/69 («جواز السفر البيومتري المنوي إبداله») ask the citizen to present it and neither names an issuing office, because there is none. If it is LOST, the procedure is different — see /ar/posts/14, which requires a declaration at a General Security regional centre. Web-checked 2026-07-29; verified_on left blank pending a teammate's read.

rows._evidence: Unresolved on both the ID-card record (cos 0.446) and the passport record. Appears across most civil-registry services, so one row here would fix many answers — which is exactly why it must not be filled from the wrong page. Suggested wordings if you decide: «تُلتقط في المركز الإقليمي للأمن العام» (follows posts/80) or «من استوديو تصوير، مصدَّقة بخاتم المختار» (follows posts/11 and 69; note the studio part is NOT stated by any source). A third honest option is to leave it unresolved and let the review queue carry the conflict.
